logline: 溫室還亮著一盞過道燈。外冷內溫——暖不是火，是玻璃裏不肯散的空氣。
youtubeTitle: [playlist] QuietLY · 暖 — Night Greenhouse / Slow English-led Jazz (Mandarin poetry islands)

comics.en: One aisle lamp is still lit in the greenhouse.
comics.zh: 溫室還亮著一盞過道燈。

comics.en: Outside is cold; inside the air stays.
Warmth is not fire — only air that will not scatter.
comics.zh: 暖不是火，是玻璃裏不肯散的空氣。

comics.en: Fog on the glass writes what the night will not say.
comics.zh: 霧玻璃寫下夜不肯說的。
